identity.name: PGA National
identity.notes: PGA National is a golf resort community in Palm Beach Gardens, FL, featuring world-class golf courses, resort amenities including pools, fitness center, tennis, spa, and multiple dining options. The community has a population of approximately 3,575 residents with a median age of 52. It operates a vacation rentals program and offers cottages with golf course vistas.

fees.note: HOA fees exist but no specific amount is stated in the available sources. The hoa-community.com page notes that all information is subject to change and should be verified directly with the association.

Reported 2026 low end: 'about $150 a month in parts of PGA National'; dues vary by subdivision/unit. Source cites Florida Luxe Estates 2026 listing data; verify with estoppel certificate before buying. PGA National comprises ~40 individual neighborhood associations (per pga-poa.com search snippet, not read).

Reported 2026 range for full-service golf & country club communities including PGA National: ~$500-$1,500/month (amount shown is the low end of the range). Excludes separate mandatory club membership.

PGA National Members Club membership (buying a home can require joining): reported 2024-2025 club schedules show six-figure buy-in plus roughly $20,000-$30,000/year in dues (amount shown is low end of range), billed separately from HOA dues. Club runs golf, tennis, and dining.

amenities.detail: World-class golf courses, open daily; includes driving range and pro shop (7am-6pm daily)
Resort pools open daily from sunrise to sunset
Fitness center and sports/racquet club, Mon-Fri 5am-8pm, Sat-Sun 5am-5pm
Tennis courts open daily 8am-9pm; racquet sports pro shop daily 7am-4pm
The Spa, Sun-Thu 9:30am-4pm, Fri-Sat 9:30am-5pm; Spa Cafe closed Oct 1-31
Multiple dining options including the mkt, birdie's diner, honeybelle, The Butcher's club, lobby bar, sushi by boū, sugarplume, and pool bar
Banyan buddies (Fri-Sun 9am-5pm) and Kid's Night Out (Fri-Sat 6pm-10pm)

Gated grounds & amenities (2026 buyer's guide, full-service golf community category). HOA dues typically fund gated security, grounds/lawn care, pools, fitness/clubhouse operations, common-area insurance, and reserves in this market segment.
Full-service golf community; the Members Club runs golf, tennis, and dining. Club membership is separate from (and often mandatory on top of) HOA dues.
